# Conyso Publishing

> Conyso Publishing is Conyso's imprint for quiz and reference books built from its free, sourced datasets, the Law Tome and the Bias Atlas. Its first book, True or Folklore? (coming soon), puts 100 famous stories to the test; each story page here gives the book's verdict (TRUE, FOLKLORE or DISPUTED), the one fact worth repeating, the popular version and the sources, and links to the Law Tome entry it is built from. The text is drafted with AI from sourced records and checked against those sources; the illustrations are made with AI. Corrections: https://conyso.com/lawtome/errata/

- [About Conyso Publishing and Its Editor](https://conyso.com/publishing/about.md): Why Conyso Publishing exists, what it publishes, how it is connected to Conyso, and who edits its books: Krishna Chagti, the founder of Conyso.
- [Conyso Publishing: Editorial Standards](https://conyso.com/publishing/standards.md): What our verdicts mean, how sources and living people are handled, what we will never do to sell a book, and how corrections work.
- [Conyso Publishing: Quiz and Reference Books, Sourced](https://conyso.com/publishing/index.md): Conyso's imprint for quiz and reference books built from the Law Tome and the Bias Atlas: drafted from sourced records, checked, corrected in public.
- [How Conyso Publishing Makes Its Books](https://conyso.com/publishing/how-we-make-books.md): The nine steps from a sourced record to a printed book, and the seven checks every Conyso Publishing title must pass before it goes on sale.
- [How Conyso Publishing Uses AI](https://conyso.com/publishing/how-we-use-ai.md): What AI does in a Conyso Publishing book (drafts the text, makes the art), what is checked around it, and what we disclose on every title.
- [The Law Tome and Bias Atlas Book Series](https://conyso.com/publishing/series.md): Conyso Publishing's two series: books built from the Law Tome's 1,116 named laws and from the Bias Atlas's 544 cognitive biases.
- [True or Folklore? Free Round: 10 Famous Scenes](https://conyso.com/publishing/true-or-folklore-round-1.md): Play round 1 of True or Folklore? free: did Archimedes shout Eureka, did an apple hit Newton? Guess, then see each verdict and its sources.
- [True or Folklore? The Myth-Busting Quiz Book](https://conyso.com/publishing/true-or-folklore.md): True or Folklore? puts 100 famous stories from science, history, money and the mind to the test. Coming soon. Play round 1 free while you wait.
